# SSE — edge-admin: Edge admin pages on the shared bus (shared/bus.js), through the hub's
# refreshOnEvents and its build-changed banner (shingo-edge/www/static/js/shingoedge.js).
# One page per section, the subscriptions as the page module makes them; "#n" is the n-th
# EventSource the page opened, "←" a frame the server sends on it. t= is the fake clock.

## Orders (orders.js), #orders-content as orders.html writes it
the page loaded: the hub (its build-changed subscription), the page module not yet
    (nothing)
refreshOnEvents("orders-content", onSSE)
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = refreshOnEvents returned 3
    #1 listens for: connected, heartbeat, order-completed, order-failed, order-update
#1 ← connected {"build":"b1","seq":1}
    (nothing)
#1 ← order-update {"id":1} id 2
    t=0 htmx.trigger(#orders-content, "sse:order-update", {"id":1})
#1 ← order-failed {"id":1} id 3
    t=0 htmx.trigger(#orders-content, "sse:order-failed", {"id":1})
#1 ← core-nodes {"nodes":[]} (a type the page did not ask for)
    (nothing)
#1 ← heartbeat {"build":"b2","seq":3}  (the Edge restarted behind a held socket)
    t=0 new-build banner shown
    the banner:
      div class="notice-banner notice-banner--info" role="status" data-banner="build"
        span class="notice-text"
          "A new version is available"
        button class="notice-action" type="button" listens=click
          "Refresh"
        button class="notice-dismiss" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" listens=click
          "×"
click the banner's Refresh
    t=0 location.reload()
click the banner's ×
    t=0 new-build banner gone

### reconnect: the bus's backoff (htmx-sse.js's was its own, 500 ms doubling to 64 s)
#1 error
    t=0 close #1
    t=1000 open #2 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    t=1000 lost-connection banner: "Lost connection to this Edge · last answered 14:00"
    = #2 opened 1000 ms after #1 closed
#2 error (no connected since the last error)
    t=1000 close #2
    t=3000 open #3 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = #3 opened 2000 ms after #2 closed
#3 error (no connected since the last error)
    t=3000 close #3
    t=7000 open #4 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = #4 opened 4000 ms after #3 closed
#4 error (no connected since the last error)
    t=7000 close #4
    t=15000 open #5 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = #5 opened 8000 ms after #4 closed
#5 error (no connected since the last error)
    t=15000 close #5
    t=25000 open #6 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = #6 opened 10000 ms after #5 closed
#6 error (no connected since the last error)
    t=25000 close #6
    t=35000 open #7 /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    = #7 opened 10000 ms after #6 closed
    #7 url /events?topics=order-completed%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
#7 ← connected {"build":"b2"}  (the new build, after the ×)
    t=35000 new-build banner shown
    t=35000 lost-connection banner gone
#7 ← connected {"build":"b2"} again, while the banner is up
    t=35000 banners: 1
#orders-content leaves the page; #7 ← order-update {"id":2}
    (nothing)

## Production (production.js): the partial's triggers first, then the page's own handlers
refreshOnEvents("production-content", onSSE); onSSE("counter-update", chart); onSSE("core-nodes", nodes)
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=core-nodes%2Ccounter-update%2Corder-failed%2Corder-update
    #1 listens for: connected, core-nodes, counter-update, heartbeat, order-failed, order-update
#1 ← counter-update {"process_id":3,"delta":2}
    t=0 htmx.trigger(#production-content, "sse:counter-update", {"process_id":3,"delta":2})
    t=0 handler chart({"process_id":3,"delta":2}, <event>)
#1 ← core-nodes {"nodes":["LN-1"]}
    t=0 handler nodes({"nodes":["LN-1"]}, <event>)

## Diagnostics (diagnostics.js): the debug feed only
setSSEQuery({debug: 1}); onSSE("debug-log", row)
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=debug-log&debug=1

## pages that hold no stream
Config, Processes, Replenishment, Kafka Direct: the hub alone (its build-changed subscription), then 60 s
    (nothing)
    = streams opened: 0
Changeover with no process picked (no #changeover-content): refreshOnEvents("changeover-content", onSSE)
    (nothing)
    = streams opened: 0
